entries.en: I met up with Futaba at the aquarium...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa... These are the most photogenic[n]fish ever!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A big crowd of people just stresses me[n]out, but a big school of fish is weirdly[n]pretty!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But man. An aquarium date? Classic[n]move. I guess we gotta do all that[n]other coupley stuff too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What, do I have to spell it out?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Couple stuff! Holding hands in the dark,[n]or cuddling up by the wall...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Um, never mind. Even talking about[n]it is getting me embarrassed.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sooo, is this payback? For Valentine's[n]Day, I mean?
Of course.
That's correct.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wow... You're so mature.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm... really, really happy.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So, is this what I think it is?
It's White Day, after all.
It's a date for White Day.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: O-Okay! We didn't hang out on[n]Valentine's Day, so I thought we were[n]basically over, and...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: W-Well, alright then! We're good!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So, is this what I think it is?
It's for White Day.
I am so, so sorry.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Well, it's not gonna make up for[n]what happened.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Not totally, anyway. But... You're here[n]with me now, so... I forgive you.
...Futaba seems pleased.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Okay, I think we hundred-percented[n]the Fish Zone.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Are you hungry? Maybe we could get[n]some food on the way home.
I already have a reservation.
I have a place in mind.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh. Uh, whoa.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Lead the way, I guess.
